**Recap**

-   Population

    -   Actual population or DGP

-   We get samples from these populations

-   If K is relatively small compared to N then the In and Out of Sample RMSE are likely to be close.

    -   This may indicate that they are not that overfit.

    -   For random sample, there is always stochasticity differences

-   More parsimonious model that captures the deep structure of the population, the less overfit that it will be (usually)

    -   Training model is fitting on a combination of the DGP and sample error

-   The richer model with more features has a greater capacity to capture the deeg structure but also for overfitting.
